marks.gloss_en: a handle, which does not protect, brings impurity in and takes it out; protection, surely
let the Torah write the handle for seeds and derive the others (oven, carcass) from it
מה לזרעים שכן טומאתן מרובה -- seeds are susceptible to much impurity
let the Torah write it for the oven and derive the others from it
מה לתנור שכן מטמא מאוירו -- an oven becomes impure from its airspace
let the Torah write it for the carcass and derive the others from it
מה לנבלה שכן מטמאה אדם, ומטמאה במשא, וטומאה יוצאה מגופה -- a carcass makes a person impure, imparts by carrying, and its impurity issues from its own body
let the Torah not write it for seeds, and derive it from oven and carcass
מה להנך שכן מטמאין שלא בהכשר -- those become impure without hechsher; seeds only with it
פירות שלא הוכשרו כתנור שלא נגמרה מלאכתו דמי -- unprepared fruit is like an oven whose work is unfinished, which is also not yet susceptible
אלא פריך הכי: מה להנך שכן מטמאין שלא בנגיעה -- those become impure without contact (airspace, carrying); seeds only by contact
let the Torah not write it for the oven, and derive it from seeds and carcass
מה להנך שכן אוכל -- those are food
let the Torah not write it for the carcass, and derive it from seeds and oven -- אין הכי נמי
the stam: the carcass's handle-verse is spare -- apply it to handles in general (to bring in)
מאי קאמר? -- the first clause excludes the hide, the second makes one touching it impure
חסורי מיחסרא -- the baraita is elliptical: no hide completing an olive-bulk, but a hide with an olive-bulk imparts (118a.3-4)
Rava: the baraita is elliptical: 'its carcass' -- not a hide without an olive-bulk of flesh, [even where] the hide completes it to an olive-bulk
ואימא: a handle brings in and not out, protection in and out -- but a handle to take out and protection to join, no
השתא עיולי מעיילא, אפוקי מיבעיא?! -- if it brings impurity in, surely it takes it out
ואימא: a handle takes out and does not bring in, protection both -- but a handle to bring in and protection to join, no
יד יתירא כתיב -- an extra handle-verse (oven and range, Lev 11:35) funds bringing in; the search for which verse is spare runs 118a.16-29
the stam: an extra handle-verse is written -- 'oven and range... impure for you' (Lev 11:35): to include the handles [of vessels]
the baraita: one might think one who touches [the hide] opposite the flesh from behind is not impure -- 'shall be impure' teaches otherwise

Rava's reading: one might think I exclude even a hide with an olive-bulk of flesh -- one touching opposite the flesh from behind would be pure, it not even acting as a handle -- 'shall be impure' teaches otherwise
Uktzin: whatever is a handle and not protection becomes impure and imparts impurity, and does not join
Uktzin: protection, even if not a handle, becomes impure, imparts impurity, and joins
the stam: 'it is impure for you' (Lev 11:38) -- whatever you need, to include the handles [of food]
the stam: 'of the animal that is for you' (Lev 11:39) -- whatever you need, to include the handles [of a carcass]
the stam: the protection the Torah wrote ('upon any sowing seed') teaches joining
the stam: rather, the carcass's handle-verse is needed
the stam: if not needed for the carcass's protection, apply it to the carcass's handle; if not to that, to handles in general -- yad to take out, yad to bring in, shomer to join
